title: MZ Using a static image for an SV actor

posts.author: punitdh89
posts.body:
Hello all,
I'm currently developing a game in RPG Maker MZ where certain states causes the actor to transform into something else for a few turns.
For example, if an actor is affected by the state "Crab", he/she will transform into a crab during the battle for a few turns.
The requirements of this plugin are that the actor must transform into a static image, not an animated one. I am not a fan of creating a 9x6 sprite sheet of the same image copied over multiple times, to make it look like it's a static image. Ideally I should be able to select an image for a given state (through notetags or plugin parameters) and have the actor automatically transform into a static image.
The issue I'm experiencing is that I'm also using
VisuStellaMZ Visual State Effects Plugin
, which is interfering with the code and causing weird unintended effects. I've tried a few other plugins on the site to no avail.
If anyone has any ideas of how to navigate this issue, that would be great.
